name: clinic-platform
description: Clinic platform monorepo. Contracts, admin web, and shared JavaScript tooling.

scripts.contracts:verify: npm run contracts:lint && npm run contracts:events && npm run contracts:generate:ts
scripts.desktop:typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/doctor-desktop && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/pharmacy-desktop
scripts.desktop:test: npm run test --workspace apps/doctor-desktop && npm run test --workspace apps/pharmacy-desktop
scripts.desktop:lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/doctor-desktop && npm run lint --workspace apps/pharmacy-desktop
scripts.desktop:package: npm run package --workspace apps/doctor-desktop && npm run package --workspace apps/pharmacy-desktop
